_notes: 1. S. Mauri: Maurus, disciple of St Benedict — 毛鲁 (also 毛禄); best Catholic form used. 2. S. Melchiadis (Miltiades): 默尔基雅德斯 is standard Catholic transliteration. 3. S. Mennæ: Menas of Egypt — 默纳, provisional. 4. S. Nonnosi: Nonnosus of Soracte — 诺诺苏斯, rare name, flagged. 5. S. Norberti: Norbert of Xanten — 诺伯特; also rendered 圣诺伯多. 6. S. Paschalis Baylon: Paschal Baylon — 帕斯卡·拜隆, flagged. 7. S. Peter Chanel / S. Pio of Pietrelcina / S. Turibius: English-language entries in the source — translated accordingly. 8. S. Petri ad Vincula: feast title (Chain of St Peter), not a saint's name per se — rendered as 圣伯多禄锁链纪念日. 9. S. Petri Chrysologi: 'Chrysologus' = 金言 (Golden Word) — rendered 金言 per Catholic convention. 10. S. Philippi Neri: almæ Urbis = of the nurturing/glorious City (Rome) — 罗马城. 11. S. Pontiani: 般丢 is the Catholic Chinese form for Pontian. 12. S. Sharbel Makhluf: Maronite hermit — 沙博尔·马克卢夫, provisional transliteration. 13. S. Sigismundi: 西吉斯蒙德, flagged. 14. S. Stanislai Kostkæ / Ioannis Berchmans: Berchmans rendered 贝尔赫曼斯. 15. S. Stephani Protomartyris: Protomartyr = 原始殉道者 (first martyr). 16. S. Symmachi: Symmachus — 息玛古, provisional. 17. S. Udalrici: Ulrich of Augsburg — 吴达尔里科; dioecesis Augustanae = 奥格斯堡教区. 18. S. Walburgæ: Walburga — 瓦尔堡加, flagged. 19. S. Zachariæ III: Zacharias — 匝加利亚 (per 思高). 20. Sacræ Columnæ Flagellationis: feast of the Holy Column of the Flagellation. 21. Archibasilicæ Ss. Salvatoris: refers to the Archbasilica of St John Lateran (dedicated to the Holy Saviour and Sts John) — rendered 至圣救主总圣殿. 22. S. Xysti entries: Xystus = Sixtus — 西斯都 per Catholic convention. 23. S. Simplici III: Simplicius — 辛普利齐. 24. S. Terésiæ Benedictæ a Cruce: Edith Stein — 艾迪特·施泰因. 25. S. Thomæ Cantuariensis: Thomas Becket of Canterbury — 坎特伯雷.
